description.en:
FORM explores the relationship between the human figure and the elemental forces of the desert.

Each image emerges from a collaboration between body, wind, time, and geology. The figure is not presented as subject, but as matter, shaped by the same forces that carve dunes and erode stone.

Within this vast, enduring terrain, the human presence becomes a fragile counterpoint, temporary, exposed, and acutely aware of scale.

The series unfolds as a meditation on solitude, scale, and resilience, inviting the viewer to pause, to breathe, and to encounter the desert not only as landscape, but as an interior state.
